CDD-0312 New Residential Building (1-2 Units) Submittal Checklist

agency: City of Sacramento Community Development Department, Building Division

who_may_file.conditions: Owner must personally perform work or assume contractor responsibility, complete Owner-Builder Acknowledgment and Information Verification Form (CDD-0220), and verify signature with driver's license or notarization.
who_may_file.quote: Building permits are not required to be signed by property owners unless they are personally performing their own work.

requirements.item: SMUD commitment letter required for all new or upgraded electrical services
requirements.quote: Note: All new or upgraded services require a commitment letter from SMUD.

requirements.item: Meter locations must be approved by SMUD Engineering Designer
requirements.quote: All meter locations must be approved by the SMUD Engineering Designer. Call Customer Service at 1-888-742-7683 to request a meter location.

requirements.item: UL-approved self-contained meter socket rated equal to or greater than service equipment
requirements.quote: Residential, self-contained meter sockets shall be UL approved and shall have a maximum current rating equal to or greater than the current rating of the associated load service equipment.

requirements.item: One-time fee and Rule 21 / PowerClerk interconnection application for solar and energy storage
requirements.quote: SMUD requires a one-time fee for all interconnection applications.

checklist.title: Streamline Residential EVSE Permit Submission Checklist (CDD-0154)

requirements.item: Completed Building Permit Application form CDD-0200 as PDF#1
requirements.quote: PDF#1-Application File: A complete permit application CDD-0200.

requirements.item: Site plan showing house on lot, service, and EVSE
requirements.quote: Site plan – show house on lot, service, and Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE).

requirements.item: One-line diagram showing service size, EV breaker, conductors, and EVSE
requirements.quote: One-line diagram – show the service size, EV breaker size, EV conductor size and number of conductors, and EVSE.

requirements.item: Load calculation worksheet CDD-0213 and manufacturer cut sheets for hardwired chargers
requirements.quote: Load Calculation work sheet CDD-0213.

load_calculation.quote: Electrical Load Calculation Worksheet. 2025 CEC 220.82 (100 AMP Minimum).

sheet_requirements.copies_or_format: Two separate PDF attachments uploaded to a sub-record under the Planning tab in the Public Permit Portal
sheet_requirements.quote: Please submit the required items as two separate PDF attachments, as outlined above, through the Public Permit Portal: https://aca-prod.accela.com/SACRAMENTO/Default.aspx.

local_rules.rule: Create sub-record under the Planning tab, not the Building tab, in Accela
local_rules.quote: Once you have created a basic user account, please create a sub-record under the Planning tab (not the Building tab).
